method: Reject empty/uniform original captures (distinct RGB colors >100). Assert Sharp for each Splashery capture and a 480x480 buffer. Verify each original PNG figure region byte-for-byte against source RGBA. The original sheets are kept in the ignored cache; their hashes are preserved in build.json. Published JPEG previews are separately checked for format, dimensions, nonempty image content, and file hashes. These checks do not measure depth accuracy or hidden-view correctness.
scope: Historical native captures and the original uncommitted PNG sheets. Original figure coordinates and exact-pixel checks do not apply to resized, lossy published JPEGs.
